description.value: Bau-Xi Gallery is one of Canada's oldest and most respected contemporary art galleries, founded in 1965 and situated on Vancouver's South Granville gallery strip. It shows a rotating programme of painting, sculpture, photography, and mixed media by Canadian and international artists, with free admission. The Granville Street corridor is a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the city's west side.
